items.subject: Petition under Sections 14 & 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for Grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 with respect to Transmission Licence to Tumkur-II RE Transmission Limited (now known as POWERGRID Tumkur Madhugiri Transmission Limited). POWERGRID Tumkur Madhugiri Transmission Limited
items.pdf_digest:
2. The Petitioner has made the following prayers:
(a) “Grant a Transmission Licence under Sections 14 and 15 of the Electricity
Act, 2003 in favour of the Applicant, TUMKUR-II RE TRANSMISSION
LIMITED, to build, own, operate and transfer of the “Transmission system
strengthening at Tumkur-II for integration of additional RE potential (2.7
GW)”, being the Inter-State transmission system; and
(b) Direct issuance of the Transmission Licence in the prescribed Form-III of
the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and
Conditions for grant of Transmission Licence and other related matters)
Regulations, 2024, subject to the general and specific conditions contained
therein; and/or
(c) Condone any minor, inadvertent or procedural defects or omissions, if any,
in the present Petition and permit the Applicant to place on record such
additional documents, information or clarifications as this Hon’ble
Commission may require from time to time in the interest of justice; and
(d) Pass such other order / orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the
facts and circumstances of the case.”
Hearing dated 4.8.2026
3. Notice was issued to the parties to file their replies and rejoinders. During
the course of the hearing, the representative of the Petitioner mainly reiterated the
submissions made in the Petition. He further submitted that CTUIL had furnished
its recommendations in support of the grant of the transmission licence. He also
submitted that the name of the Petitioner company had been changed and sought
liberty to file an affidavit along with the relevant supporting documents to place the
said change on record.
4. Vide the Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as the ‘RoP’) dated
4.8.2026, the Petitioner was directed to implead GR Infra as a party to the Petition
and file an amended memo of parties. Thereafter, necessary amendments, if any,
were also directed to be carried out in the Petition in terms of Regulation 37(2) of
the Conduct of Business Regulations. The Petitioner was further directed to file an
affidavit, placing on record the change in the name of the Petitioner company.
Order in Petition No. 329/TL/2026
Page 7

5. In compliance with the RoP dated 4.8.2026, the Petitioner, vide affidavit
dated 12.8.2026, placed on record the amended memo of parties. The Petitioner
also placed on record, vide affidavit dated 12.8.2026, the change in the name of
the Petitioner company from “Tumkur-II RE Transmission Limited” to
“POWERGRID Tumkur Madhugiri Transmission Limited”, along with the Certificate
of Incorporation dated 27.7.2026.
Hearing dated 3.9.2026
6. During the hearing, the representative of the Petitioner submitted that the
Petitioner has complied with the directions issued vide RoP dated 4.8.2026. He
further submitted that, pursuant to the said RoP, the Respondents were granted an
opportunity to file their replies; however, none of the Respondents has filed any
reply. Accordingly, after hearing the representative for the Petitioner, the matter
was reserved for order.
7. The Petitioner has submitted that in accordance with the “Guidelines for
Encouraging Competition in Development of Transmission Projects” and “Tariff
Based Competitive Bidding Guidelines for Transmission Service” (hereinafter
referred to as “the Guidelines”) issued by the Ministry of Power, Government of
India, under Section 63 of the Act, PFC Consulting Limited (hereinafter referred
to as “PFCCL”) was notified by the Ministry of Power, Government of India, vide
Gazette Notification. No. CG-DL-E-21082025-265554 dated 19.8.2025 as the Bid
Process Coordinator (hereinafter referred to as “BPC”) for the purpose of
selection of bidder as the Transmission Service Provider (hereinafter referred to
as “TSP”) to establish the inter-state “Transmission System Strengthening at
Tumkur-II for Integration of Additional RE Potential (2.7 GW)”.
8. PFCCL, in its capacity as the BPC, initiated the bid process on 19.11.2025
Order in Petition No. 329/TL/2026
Page 8

with the various regulations of the Central Electricity Authority regarding Technical
Standards and Grid Standards, Prudent Utility Practices and other applicable laws.
Further, Article 5.4 of the TSA provides that the TSP shall ensure that the Project
is designed, built and completed in a good workman-like manner using sound
engineering and construction practices and using only materials and equipment
that are new and of international utility-grade quality such that the useful life of the
Project will be till the expiry date. Further, the design, construction, and testing of
all equipment, facilities, components, and systems of the Project shall be in
accordance with Indian Standards and Codes issued by the Bureau of Indian
Standards. In this regard, the Petitioner has submitted that it will implement the
Project in accordance with the provisions of the TSA. It is expected that while
carrying out the survey, the Petitioner has complied with the provisions of clause
2.5.7.3, clause 2.5.7.4, and clause 2.5.7.5 of the RfP. The Petitioner will comply
with the provisions of the bidding documents and the TSA for the commissioning of
the Project within the SCOD.
27. The Petition shall be listed for final hearing on 5.11.2026.
Sd/- sd/- sd/-

Ishanagar Power Transmission Limited

the elements under instant scheme.”
7. A public notice under Sub-section (5) of Section 15 of the Act was published
in all editions of the Indian Express (English) and Hindustan (Hindi) on 6.8.2026. No
suggestions/ objections have been received from members of the public in response
to the public notice.
Hearing Dated 13.8.2026
8. During the hearing on 13.8.2026, the learned counsel for the Petitioner
submitted that, subsequent to the Interim Order dated 1.8.2026, CTUIL, vide its
communication dated 7.8.2026, had awarded an additional scope under the RTM to
the Petitioner, comprising one 400 kV line bay, including the main bay and
associated tie bay, for interconnection of NTPC Barethi Solar Park, which pertains to
the same Ishanagar (New) Sub-station, and accordingly sought permission to
amend the Petition to include the said additional scope.
9. The representative of CTUIL submitted that, pursuant to the directions of the
Commission dated 27.5.2026, CTUIL had uploaded its compliance affidavit dated
15.7.2026. However, due to an inadvertent error, only the word version was
uploaded and the PDF version of the affidavit could not be uploaded. He further
submitted that the compliance affidavit addressing the queries raised in the earlier
RoPs/ orders was ready and sought liberty to file the same during the course of the
day.
10. In addition, during the hearing, the learned counsel for Respondent No. 31,
Avaada Energy Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as “AEPL”), submitted that
certain information/ responses required from CTUIL pursuant to the Interim Order
dated 1.8.2026 were still pending, to which the representative of CTUIL submitted
Order in Petition No. 206/TL/2026 Page 7

that the same would be addressed in its compliance affidavit.
11. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) dated
13.8.2026, CTUIL was directed to file its compliance affidavit in terms of the Interim
Order dated 1.8.2026. In addition, on the leave sought by the Petitioner for filing an
application for amendment of the present Petition, it was observed that upon
incorporation of an additional element/ scope, the Petitioner may again be required
to follow the procedure under Regulation 5 of the Transmission Licence Regulations,
2024 in respect of the amended Petition and the Petitioner may, therefore, first
examine the proper course of action under the extant regulatory framework before
moving an application seeking amendment of this Petition at this stage.
12. In compliance with Order/ RoP, CTUIL, vide affidavit dated 17.8.2026, has
submitted as under:
a) In compliance with the directions issued vide RoP dated 27.5.2026 and
the interim order dated 1.8.2026, the Petitioner, CTUIL had submitted its
response with regard to the Petitioner`s e-mail dated 5.12.2025 seekng
clarification regarding the cost estimate approved under the Office
Memorandum dated 4.11.2025. The Petitioner specifically requested
clarification as to whether the approved cost estimate included components
towards Interest During Construction (hereinafter referred to as “IDC”) and
Incidental Expenditure During Construction (hereinafter referred to as
“IEDC”), and, if so, the percentage considered under each of these heads.
Although no separate reply was furnished to the Petitioner, the relevant
details were later submitted as under:
i. The cost estimate for the subject transmission scheme was worked
Order in Petition No. 206/TL/2026 Page 8

The final grant was issued on 10.8.2026, with a firm start date of
Connectivity as 7.8.2028. It may be noted that the in-principle grant
indicated the start date as 28.2.2029, considering implementation
schedule of 400 kV line bay at Ishanagar S/s end as 30 months.
However, based on the request of MNRE for preponement, the subject
bay was awarded with implementation schedule of 24 months.
d) CTUIL also made further reference to the Commission's orders dated
31.1.2025 in Petition No. 437/TL/2024 and dated 6.4.2024 in Petition No.
123/TL/2023, wherein the implementation timelines of RTM projects were
aligned with the revised timelines furnished by CTUIL while granting the
transmission licence, support the Respondent's limited request in the
present case. Since the subject bay is generator-specific and its
beneficial use depends upon the readiness of the associated generating
station and interconnection facilities, its implementation schedule ought
to be aligned with the actual project readiness and the coordinated
Ishanagar connectivity arrangement, rather than being treated as an
isolated asset. Such a direction would cause no prejudice to the
Petitioner and the transmission licence may be granted subject to the
usual conditions.
e) Based on the request of AEPL and CTUIL OM dated 04.11.2025, the
1 no. 400 kV line bay at Ishanagar (New) S/s allotted to AEPL is required
to be implemented by Ishanagar Power Transmission Limited (a
subsidiary of IndiGrid 2 Pvt Ltd.) with an implementation timeframe of
30.6.2027, being the start date of Connectivity sought by AEPL itself.
However, AEPL during the 52nd WR-JCC meeting held on 18/9.6.2026,
